verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official CLI (bru) that runs API collections from the command line. The docs say it integrates with CI/CD pipelines, and official Docker images run it in CI without Node.js on the host. It also documents GitHub Actions and Docker runs, JUnit/JSON/HTML reports, runtime environment-variable overrides, and a Safe Mode sandbox default. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of headless/CI runs.
